description: Header file defining the QuicSimpleServerStream class, which manages HTTP/QUIC stream handling in a simple QUIC server implementation, including request processing, response generation, and error handling.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServerStream
classes.description: Represents a server-side QUIC stream handling HTTP requests and responses, including request parsing, response sending, and error handling within a QUIC session.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServerStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with session and backend references.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of header reception.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Called when the stream is ready to send data.

methods.name: OnBodyAvailable
methods.description: Called when body data is available to read.

methods.name: OnInvalidHeaders
methods.description: Handles invalid header scenarios.

methods.name: OnResponseBackendComplete
methods.description: Callback when backend response is ready.

methods.name: SendStreamData
methods.description: Sends data on the stream.

methods.name: TerminateStreamWithError
methods.description: Terminates the stream with an error.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Generates and sends a response based on backend data.

methods.name: HandleRequestConnectData
methods.description: Processes data received for CONNECT requests.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends the HTTP response headers and body.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends a 500 error response.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response with specific code.

methods.name: SendNotFoundResponse
methods.description: Sends a 404 not found response.

methods.name: SendIncompleteResponse
methods.description: Sends response headers and body without fin.

methods.name: SendHeadersAndBody
methods.description: Sends headers and body.

methods.name: SendHeadersAndBodyAndTrailers
methods.description: Sends headers, body, and trailers.

methods.name: request_headers
methods.description: Accesses the request headers.

methods.name: IsConnectRequest
methods.description: Checks if the request is a CONNECT request.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the request body.

methods.name: WriteGeneratedBytes
methods.description: Writes generated bytes for response.

methods.name: set_quic_simple_server_backend_for_test
methods.description: Sets backend for testing.

methods.name: response_sent
methods.description: Checks if response has been sent.

methods.name: set_response_sent
methods.description: Marks response as sent.
